disclaimer: Sizes and timings are rough real-world approximations for teaching.

fieldGuide.family: Colour family. Colour is never the only cue: every type also has its own shape.
fieldGuide.shape: Particle and legend shape id from assets/shapes.js.
fieldGuide.sizeKb: Typical payload, used for bandwidth and egress cost.
fieldGuide.interactive: A person is waiting; counts toward the latency SLO.
fieldGuide.async: Usually fine to finish later; a queue may acknowledge it and the work completes downstream.
fieldGuide.isWrite: Counts against capacity.writeRps on stores and changes data.
fieldGuide.durable: Losing it after it was acknowledged is a data-safety failure.
fieldGuide.cacheable: Caches and CDNs may answer it.
fieldGuide.idempotent: Running it twice is harmless by nature. When false, duplicates are a data-safety failure unless an idempotency store is on the path.
fieldGuide.defaultLatencyBudgetMs: Used when a problem gives no latency target for this type.

types.name: Read
types.description: Fetch something to show: open a page, load a profile, follow a short link.

types.name: Write
types.description: Save something: post a comment, update a profile, create a short link.

types.name: Upload
types.description: Send a file: a photo, a video, a document. Processing usually happens afterwards.
examples: Attach a scan to a claim

types.name: Stream chunk
types.description: A few seconds of video or audio; a player fetches one every 2 to 6 seconds.

types.name: Live segment
types.description: A piece of a live broadcast; everyone watching wants the same piece at the same moment.

types.name: Search
types.description: Find things by words, filters or meaning.

types.name: Report
types.description: An analytics question over many rows: a dashboard tile, a monthly statement.

types.name: Payment
types.description: Move money: charge a card, transfer between accounts. Must happen exactly once.

types.name: Sign-in
types.description: Prove who you are and get a token; later requests carry the token.

types.name: AI request
types.description: Ask a model: one chatbot reply (about 400 words-pieces out) or one prediction.

types.name: Message
types.description: A chat message or a game move that other people should see within a moment.

types.name: Location ping
types.description: A GPS update from a phone or vehicle, every few seconds.

types.name: Notification
types.description: Tell a person something: push, email or text.

types.name: Sync change
types.description: A small change to shared state that must reach every device in order: a keystroke in a shared doc, a changed file block.

types.name: Telemetry batch
types.description: A batch of about 100 readings from a device or agent.

types.name: Analytics event
types.description: A record that something happened: a click, a view, a purchase.

types.name: Batch task
types.description: One chunk of a big offline job, about 100 MB of data.

types.name: Webhook
types.description: A call from or to a partner that says something changed, such as 'payment succeeded'.

types.name: Attack traffic
types.description: Junk from bots or a flood. It never succeeds, but it uses capacity wherever it reaches until a filter drops it.
